        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OffersReceived" name="Offers received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEventDef_OffersReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offers"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectOffer" name="Select one offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPostShipment" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountMerge" name="Shipping method determined"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Start preparation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" name="Insurance necessary?" default="Flow_NoInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance decision done"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadyJoin" name="Goods ready"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ShippingRequired" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${largeAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Event_OffersReceived" targetRef="Task_SelectOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectOffer" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInsurance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
